brief:
Drop Site News reported that Trump has adopted a lower-profile approach to Iran, stepping back from more confrontational rhetoric on the relationship between the two countries. The strategic shift represents a notable change in how the administration is publicly framing its stance toward Tehran.

Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu rejected a proposed balance-of-power arrangement aimed at resolving the conflict in Gaza, according to Drop Site News. The rebuff came as Ukrainian forces conducted a strike on a Russian oil refinery, killing at least 13 workers in an attack on the energy facility. The operation underscores Ukraine's continued targeting of Russian industrial infrastructure supporting the war effort.
title: Trump downplays Iran tensions as Netanyahu blocks Gaza peace plan
